extracted.intended_audience: existing HBO subscribers and prospective HBO/HBO Max customers (general consumers)
extracted.subtask_description: Consumer-facing instructions for obtaining and activating HBO Max access, covering eligibility (existing HBO subscribers vs new customers), device/app installation, provider sign-in, and subscription/plan notes (e.g., ad-free required for same-day movie releases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for HBO Max access (existing HBO subscribers)
rubrics_metrics.description: HBO Max is available to nearly all existing HBO subscribers. 'Yes - You likely have access to HBO Max at no extra charge!'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you currently subscribe to HBO, follow the activation steps below to gain access to HBO Max. The page implies you should check your subscription status first; specific provider or account linking may be required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Install HBO Max app on a supported device
rubrics_metrics.description: Install the HBO Max app on a supported device.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The first activation step is to install the app on a supported device. (The page references 'supported device' but does not list devices here; users should select the appropriate device store or platform to download the app.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Sign in with a Provider to activate access
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign in to HBO Max by choosing 'Sign in with a Provider' on the sign-in screen. Then choose your provider and enter your provider account credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the required sign-in flow for many subscribers whose HBO access is provided through a TV or other provider. The page includes a link ('Click here to sign in with your provider') to begin this process. Ensure you use the provider account credentials associated with your HBO subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-subscriber pathway: get HBO / sign up
rubrics_metrics.description: If you do not have HBO, the page directs you to 'Get HBO.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New customers must subscribe to HBO (or otherwise sign up via available plans) to obtain HBO Max access; follow the provided 'Get HBO' / sign-up links to create an account or purchase a plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad-free plan required for same-day Warner Bros. movie premieres
rubrics_metrics.description: HBO Max subscribers can stream Warner Bros. Pictures movie premieres the same day as they hit theaters. (Only available on the ad-free plan.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If same-day theatrical premieres are important to you, choose the ad-free HBO Max plan. Users on ad-supported plans should not expect same-day streaming of Warner Bros. theatrical premieres.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content scope and offerings
rubrics_metrics.description: HBO Max features 10,000 hours of premium content bundling all of HBO together with more movies, shows, and Max Originals for the whole family, including named titles and collections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page lists example titles (Friends, South Park, The Big Bang Theory, Peacemaker, Hacks, Wonder Woman, Studio Ghibli collection) to illustrate the catalogue breadth and family-friendly/collection offerings. This describes what subscribers can expect from the service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Migration/launch date notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Notification that 'HBO Max Becomes on May 23' and that users with existing HBO Max through an HBO subscription will get access to Max on that date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timing and rollout details: users should be aware of the specific migration/availability date (May 23) mentioned for access changes or platform rebranding; follow any date-specific instructions provided by your provider.
